verdict.rationale: The SDK's core purpose is task delegation to a built-in Claude agent. A single `query(prompt=...)` call runs an agent loop that calls built-in tools to read and edit files, run commands and search the web until the task is complete, and it can spawn subagents for focused subtasks. Delegation happens through code rather than an in-app UI assistant, so the user must write Python or TypeScript to hand off tasks. Missing for 10: a no-code or in-UI way to delegate tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Claude evaluates your prompt, calls tools to take action, receives the results, and repeats until the task is complete.
Use the Agent SDK to build an AI agent that reads your code, finds bugs, and fixes them, all without manual intervention.
The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code, programmable in Python and TypeScript.
Subagents are separate agent instances that your main agent can spawn to handle focused subtasks.
